survey.title: Clinician Use of Incretin-Based Therapies in Type 2 Diabetes

sourceAnchor.quote: Which of the following GLP-1 or dual-incretin therapies do you currently prescribe for type 2 diabetes?

obligations.requirement: Q1. Which of the following GLP-1 or dual-incretin therapies do you currently prescribe for type 2 diabetes?
expectedObservables: Question Q1 is displayed with text: "Which of the following GLP-1 or dual-incretin therapies do you currently prescribe for type 2 diabetes?"

Option 2: "MOUNJARO"
Option 3: "TRULICITY"

Option 99: "None of the above"
